title: Links with other networks
description: Link this network to another independent network by exchanging a signed code with its administrator.

actions.create: Create a code for another network

revoke.title: Revoke the link with {{name}}?
revoke.body: The other network loses access immediately.
revoke.failed: The link was not revoked: the other network still has access. Try again.

create.title: Create a code for another network
create.body: Create a signed code to send to the administrator of the other network. The code contains the terms you are offering.
create.endpoint: Address of this network, as the other network will reach it
create.endpointInvalid: The address must start with https://.
create.subnetsInvalid: Write address ranges like 10.0.0.0/8, separated by commas.
create.failed: The code was not created. Check the address and try again.

paste.title: Paste a code you received
paste.body: Paste the code you received from the other network's administrator. The code is checked before it is accepted.
paste.invalid: This code is invalid or damaged. Ask the other network to send a new one.
paste.failed: The link was not accepted. Try again.
paste.accepted: Code accepted: the link has been created.
paste.fingerprintBody: Ask the other administrator to read this fingerprint to you by phone or in person. Accept only if it matches.
paste.fingerprintConfirm: The fingerprint matches, accept the code

empty.title: No links with other networks
empty.body: Create a code and send it to the administrator of the other network.

error.load: The links could not be loaded. Try again.
